title: Viasat KA-SAT attack (2022) - CCDCOE International cyber law toolkit / EU + Five Eyes attribution
content: On May 10, the EU and the Five Eyes governments (US, UK, Australia, New Zealand, Canada) released public statements attributing AcidRain to the Russian military intelligence (GRU), linking it to multiple families of destructive wiper malware including WhisperGate.

onward_citations.citation: EU Council / national MFA statements (no published base-rate fraction)
